title: db_domain's scratch-lifetime proof mints its companion through its own store
intention: db_domain's scratch-lifetime proof mints its killed-minter companion through db_domain's own store instead of standing up a bus, so db_domain's proofs reach no device.
why: Measured 2026-11-05 after sibling ad7caca4d54c PROVED: encapsulation_breaches lists cairn/devices/db_domain/proofs/test_scratch_cannot_outlive_its_process.py:98 -> cairn.devices.cairn.machines.bus.bus (into_device). The tooth used BusDevice.scratch only to get a scratch table with a registered _delivery companion; store.register_scratch_companion (store.py:528) is db_domain's own primitive for exactly that. RULE 1: a component reaches another only through its public interface.
traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation); Law 4 (encapsulation_breaches is the physics and this row is its open debt); Law 8 (the tooth keeps a companion a hollow sweep could not drop).
how: _fork_minter's bus branch becomes store.scratch + create_owned_table(<table>_delivery) + register_scratch_companion; with_bus -> with_companion; a red-first proof reds the reach.
falsifier: (1) encapsulation_breaches lists no row whose source is cairn/devices/db_domain; (2) _fork_minter mints its companion through store alone (the file names no cairn.devices.cairn module) and test_a_killed_minter_is_swept_with_its_delivery_companion is green twice serially. Wrong intent if the sweep's companion handling cannot be exercised without a bus.

decisions.text: D1: SETTLED: in cairn/devices/db_domain/proofs/test_scratch_cannot_outlive_its_process.py _fork_minter, the child's 'with_bus' branch (lines 98-107: the BusDevice import, its comment, and 'with BusDevice.scratch(prefix, device_id=f"{prefix}_rider") as bus: bus.read(); os.write(w, bus.table.encode())...') becomes: 'with store.scratch(_OWNER, prefix, _COLUMNS) as table:' then, when with_companion, 'companion = f"{table}_delivery"', 'store.create_owned_table(companion, _OWNER, _COLUMNS)', 'store.register_scratch_companion(table, companion)'; then os.write(w, table.encode()), os.close(w), signal.pause() as today. One branch, no if/else duplication of the write and pause. The comment names store's companion primitive as what the bus's _ensure also uses (bus.py:392-400). WHERE: the module cairn.devices.db_domain.tools.client.store (file cairn/devices/db_domain/tools/client/store.py), already imported at line 48 of the proof as 'store'; its scratch is at cairn/devices/db_domain/tools/client/store.py:607, create_owned_table at :179, register_scratch_companion at :550 — all present today.

D2: SETTLED: the keyword 'with_bus' becomes 'with_companion' in _fork_minter's signature, its docstring ('and, with the bus, its receipt companion' -> 'and, with_companion, a registered _delivery companion'), and both callers (line 219 with_companion=True, line 293 with_companion=False).

D3: SETTLED: the module docstring's clause (2) wording 'leaves its table AND the ``_delivery`` companion the bus registered' becomes 'leaves its table AND a ``_delivery`` companion registered beside it (store.register_scratch_companion, the call the bus's _ensure makes)'. The PROVES of 201a37bf1613 is unchanged.

D4: SETTLED: the red-first proof is cairn/devices/db_domain/proofs/test_db_domain_proofs_reach_no_device.py, committed alone before the build, PROVES = {'7bc784d5a7de': {'1': 'test_no_db_domain_row', '2': 'test_the_killed_minter_mints_through_the_store'}} written with the literal key. Tooth 1: encapsulation_breaches(repo root) — cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py:4454, imported as cairn.machines.build_inspector.inspector — has no row whose 'source' == 'cairn/devices/db_domain'. Tooth 2: cairn/devices/db_domain/proofs/test_scratch_cannot_outlive_its_process.py's text contains no 'cairn.devices.cairn' and the source of its _fork_minter function (ast segment) contains 'register_scratch_companion'; then load the file by importlib at call time and call test_a_killed_minter_is_swept_with_its_delivery_companion() (raises on failure). main() runs each tooth under the check/FAILURES pattern of cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_base_proofs_ride_the_live_bus.py. WHERE: test_a_killed_minter_is_swept_with_its_delivery_companion already exists at test_scratch_cannot_outlive_its_process.py:218; this build changes only its _fork_minter call (D2).

D5: SETTLED: run cairn/devices/db_domain/proofs/test_db_domain_proofs_reach_no_device.py and cairn/devices/db_domain/proofs/test_scratch_cannot_outlive_its_process.py twice serially with 'PYTHONPATH=. python3 <file>' from the cairn root; then reseal the changed proof with 'bin/cairn test --seal --ruling 7bc784d5a7de cairn/devices/db_domain/proofs/test_scratch_cannot_outlive_its_process.py' and commit as '7bc784d5a7de: db_domain's scratch-lifetime proof mints its companion through its own store' with the two trailer lines.
